name: Arty Flare
source:
"The sparkling light is proof of courage!!"

A male student with a high magical aptitude attending a magic academy. Despite the fact that women are said to have higher magical talents than men, an incident that occurs during the story causes him to turn into a woman. As a result, his already high magical aptitude is further enhanced, and he possesses tremendous magical power. 

He is honest, single-minded, hardworking, and straightforward, and often inspires those around him to become more positive, making him a secret favorite among his peers. Despite becoming a woman and shrinking by one size, his inner self has not changed at all. Therefore, due to the fact that his female appearance turned out to be a beautiful girl of unparalleled beauty, he has become even more popular than before.

In the past, he was involved in a magical disaster of such magnitude that his hometown was destroyed (monsters spilled out from a dimensional crack), and he sincerely respects and aspires to be like the "magical girl" who saved him at that time. He never dreamed that he would actually become a "magical girl" himself...

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/8M5gaYo.jpg]official character description[/url]]
